dossier.summary: Tidewater Health Partners runs six outpatient clinics on the coast and employs about 700 people.
dossier.why_now: Opened its sixth clinic in September.

notes.title: Call notes, Oct 8
notes.text: Oct 8 intro call with Marcus Bell (COO) and Ines Calderon (Director of Patient Access). Front desks at all six clinics take intake on paper and re-key it. They want one intake flow live at two clinics first.

notes.title: Call notes, Oct 20
notes.text: Oct 20 working session with Ahmed Rahimi (Compliance Officer). Ahmed needs the data handling answers in writing and a call with our security lead, Tobias Lind.

notes.title: Call notes, Oct 28
notes.text: Oct 28 Hannah sent the data handling pack and a draft rollout plan. Marcus wants a decision by Nov 20 so the first two clinics can go live before the holidays. Next call Thu Nov 5 at 2:00 PM ET, 45 minutes.

company.title: Our deal team and what we share with buyers
company.text: Team: Hannah Ortiz, enterprise account executive. Tobias Lind, security lead. Mei Tanaka, implementation manager. Shared with buyers: data handling pack for healthcare (PDF, 11 pages), rollout plan template for multi-clinic groups (PDF, 4 pages), customer story: Harbor Pediatrics (PDF, 5 pages).

data.lede: One room for the patient intake rollout across Tidewater's clinics, so Marcus, Ines and Ahmed can see the plan and the paperwork in one place.
data.note: Marcus, this page puts the intake rollout, the compliance questions and the paperwork in one place. The plan is my draft of the steps between now and a go-live at two clinics, so tell me what is off before Thursday's call. Ahmed has the data handling pack, and Tobias will be on the call for his questions.
